purpose: Formal inventory and provenance manifest for the Stage-6 main experimental dataset v1.0. This file identifies the exact canonical run membership and frozen inputs; it does not redefine benchmark methodology or metrics.

prompts.selection_rule: use the next 24 deterministic Stage-3 records after the Stage-5 pilot: selection_rank 8..31; none may be marked pilot

canonical_artifact_contract.repository_policy: Canonical results/runs and results/summary.parquet are local experimental artifacts and may be excluded from Git/portable snapshots; this manifest preserves exact Stage-6 run membership and hashes the frozen summary index.

reliability_inventory.note: Reliability is normative over the full text channel (sender token IDs -> text -> retokenization -> receiver token IDs -> decoder).

provenance_notes: Stage-6 operating points were frozen at Stage 5; Stage 6 did not continue parameter tuning.
Streaming methods and RRC fixed-payload semantics remain separate.
Both KL directions are retained according to ADR-0012.
metric_instrumentation is excluded from stegomethod timings according to ADR-0020.
Direct sender-token decoding is diagnostic only; normative reliability uses the full text channel.
